profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer 3 at DENSO
profile.summary:
Firmware developer of Microchip and Freescale 8-bit/16-bit MCU using Assembly or ANSI C language in barebones configuration. 

I have also developed firmwares for ARM Cortex-M MCUs using ANSI C language in barebones CMSIS or with supplied SDK from chip manufacturer.

Experienced PCB designer from schematic capture to PCB layout using Target3001 and EagleCAD

Experienced Project Manager that works with all related party from design concept, validation testing, parts approval process to production hand off

Experienced Test and  Validation Engineer in automotive environmental and electrical design validation process using custom built controllers, LabView, and Visual Basic.

* Developed Bluetooth Low Energy Software Modules using TI BLE5 SDK and TI-RTOS for Volvo's Phone-as-Key System

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for new products developments. Creates project design base on customer requirements and proceeds to develop prototypes for proof of theory.

* Responsible for software/firmware development for all microcontroller based products.

* Responsible for creating electronic schematics and PCB artworks

* Responsible for validation testing on products per customer specifications

* Responsible for project management on new products from concept to production hand-off

* Responsible for Failure Analysis on all PCBA products 

Designed the electronics and wrote the firmware for Curt Manufacturing's Discovery, Venturer, and Triflex Brake Controls

Designed the electronics and wrote the firmware for a MOPAR OEM Trailer Light Converter Module

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for software/firmware development for all microcontroller based products.
* Responsible for creating electronic schematics and PCB artworks
* Bridges the Engineering Team and Production Team to make sure production line are in maximum efficiency
* Troubleshoots production failures
* Bridges Engineering and Quality Control Team to make sure all outgoing products are in specifications

Designed the electronics and wrote the firmware of Valley Industries' Blackbird and Phantom Brake Controls

Designed the electronics and wrote the firmware of Cequent's Activator III Brake Control

patents.title: Portable Brake Controller with Wireless Control Interface
patents.description: A brake controller (10) is provided as an inline plug between the towing vehicle (12) and the towed vehicle or trailer. The electronics including an accelerometer (IC2) and wireless communication radio (62) are potted within a brake controller housing package (20). There is no conventional display or input controls on the exterior of the brake controller package (20). Input settings, and possibly output messages, are communicated through a smartphone or similar software or hardware application. The brake controller (10) can identify a hazard lighting condition and avoid braking the towed vehicle during the hazard lighting condition, and can also distinguish when braking during signaling a turn, using the turn signals of the towing vehicle (12).

patents.title: Proportional Brake Controller
patents.description: A system, device, and method for providing braking power to a trailer proportional to the deceleration of a towing vehicle.
